verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe with a standard pipeline user agent got HTTP 200 on the WyoBiz root, which redirects to the public Business Center page, reachable without a key. Only filing actions sit behind an account. Guidance text from several sos.wyo.gov pages (Business, Forms, MaintainBusiness, StartABusiness) was extracted as readable content, and the 404s on probe paths show the server answers plainly rather than returning a bot-wall 403 or a challenge. Missing for 10: an explicit 200 probe on the sos.wyo.gov guidance pages themselves, explicit confirmation of no JS-only rendering or CAPTCHA, and a machine-readable robots.txt policy (it returns HTML).
